query: For my 56-year-old male, among males 51–61 with primary hemorrhagic stroke, what is the SD of length of stay (days)?
final_sql: SELECT stddev(icustays.los) AS standard_deviation FROM patients JOIN icustays ON patients.subject_id = icustays.subject_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_age = 56 AND icustays.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM diagnoses_icd WHERE icd_code = '887.1' AND icd_version = '2019-09-01');
